title: D2P Material Physics Profile
description: Versioned vocabulary of cloth physics parameters for one material (design decision ADR-029 §5 rule 7, ADR-021 §9): material class, areal density, thickness, stretch, shear and bending stiffness and friction. The values are coarse and 'provisional' until a measurement procedure and calibration against real fabric samples are defined; user interfaces label them as such. Files are stored as vocabularies/material-physics-profiles/<local>-<version>.json for profileId d2p:<local>.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

profileId.description: Qualified name of the profile; with version it identifies the profile.

version.description: Version of the profile, independent of the standard version.

status.description: provisional: proposed values, not to be used for comparing implementations; frozen: adopted and immutable (a changed value is a new version).

materialClass.description: Material class the profile describes; it equals the declared class of every material assignment it is used for (D2P-SEM-128).

friction.description: Dynamic friction coefficient against the body (dimensionless).

notes.description: Free-text notes on provenance, measurement method and status of the values.

materialStretchStiffness.title: Material stretch stiffness
materialStretchStiffness.description: Stretch stiffness along warp (lengthwise) and weft (crosswise) in N/m.

materialBendingStiffness.title: Material bending stiffness
materialBendingStiffness.description: Bending stiffness along warp and weft in µN·m.
